slides.reveal: Answer: A. Smaller worlds have more surface area for their volume, so they cool faster (LPI, OpenStax, slide 4); Mars (6,792 km across) is about half Earth's diameter (12,756 km) and has cooled more.

PART 4  ·  WATER & WHY EARTH IS UNIQUE

slides.reveal: Answer: A. NASA: the Martian atmosphere is too thin for liquid water to exist for long on the surface (surface pressure 6.36 mb vs Earth's 1014 mb, NASA Fact Sheets); Mars lost much of its air to space (slide 15) because it is small and has no global magnetic field.
